title: Will the Prince Get True Love’s Kiss? On the Model Sensitivity to Gender Perturbation over Fairytale Texts

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual Data Augmentation (CDA) by swapping gendered nouns and pronouns in the FairytaleQA dataset using rule-based and LLM-assisted methods. The bias is evaluated by measuring the performance drop (ROUGE-L F1 scores) of fine-tuned question-answering models (T5 and BART) on the gender-perturbed test data, and by assessing bias propagation and inclusivity in open-ended fairytale generation using GPT-3.5.
